Swastik Academy – Highly Recommended

I cannot express enough how grateful I am for the outstanding tuition services provided by Subodh Sir in Swastik Academy. My experience with them has been nothing short of transformative, both for my academic performance and my overall confidence.

From the very first session, it was evident that the tutors here are not only knowledgeable but also incredibly passionate about teaching. They have a unique ability to explain complex concepts in a way that is easy to understand, making even the most challenging subjects manageable. The personalized attention I received ensured that all my specific needs and learning styles were catered to, which made a significant difference in my understanding and retention of the material.

What sets this tuition service apart is their commitment to each student's success. The tutors go above and beyond to provide additional resources, practice materials, and constructive feedback. They are always approachable, encouraging questions and fostering a positive and engaging learning environment. The small class sizes also mean that each student gets ample individual attention, which is crucial for effective learning.

Since enrolling in these tuitions, my grades have improved dramatically. More importantly, I have developed a genuine interest and enthusiasm for the subjects I once struggled with. The improvement in my academic performance has also boosted my confidence, which has positively impacted other areas of my life.

In conclusion, I highly recommend Swastik Academy to anyone seeking quality tuition services. Their professional, dedicated, and caring approach to teaching is truly commendable. Whether you need help catching up, want to excel further, or are preparing for important exams, this is the place to be. My journey from diploma till Bachelor in Civil Engineering would not be possible without Subodh Sir. Thank you, Subodh Sir, for making such a positive impact on my educational journey!

Best wishes,
Kaustubh Raut.
MSc Construction Project Management.

featured_reviews.name: moksha parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I spent 11 years in this school and completed my 10+2 (Science) here. My admission was taken by Principal Mathew, who was a very cheerful and welcoming person. Over the years, many things changed in the school, but it certainly taught me discipline and consistency in studies.

My journey had both good and challenging experiences. At times, I faced mental harassment and uncomfortable situations. However, I appreciate that the Student Support Team and Manager Sir handled those matters responsibly and supported students when needed.

In the beginning, I was appointed as the Yellow House Prefect and faced demotivation due to partial behaviour from a teacher. Nevertheless, I proved myself later by becoming the Yellow House Captain, and during my tenure our house achieved the first rank. That remains one of the proudest memories of my school life.

There are countless memories attached to this place. Even today, when I pass by the school, those memories come rushing back. The infrastructure may have changed, but the emotional connection remains the same.

However, it is disappointing to hear that some of the issues that existed during my time are still being reported today. The management and teachers should focus more on professionalism and creating a supportive and respectful environment for students.

Despite everything, this school will always remain an important part of my life, holding both good and challenging memories. I also found the love here, and hence there are many special memories connected to this place.
